description.narrative: This project is to provide technical support to the United Nations Organization Stabilization Mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (MONUSCO). The objective is to provide the additional technical assistance required by MONUSCO for its extensive geographical presence and activities at multiple locations in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) to attain its key performance. Desired outcomes are a higher resource mobility and flexibility enabling the Mission to achieve cost efficiencies and maximum utilization of resources.\nSpecifically, UNOPS has been requested to provide operational assistance to MONUSCO that requires various Technical Support Services in two fields: (1) Maintenance and construction services such as carpentry, masonry, Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) services, generator maintenance, warehouse services, cleaning, welding, painting, facilities and camp management, drivers, helpers, electrical service in multiple locations in DRC; (2) Translation and Interpretation services for the UN Police (UNPOL), military observers and military forces in the various languages as required (French, English, Spanish and local languages) for all operational requirement in multiple locations in DRC.
